title: config/pipeline.yaml — this install's identity, paths, thresholds, pack selection

pack.description: Active pack name under packs/ (default: product).

name.description: Candidate full name — audit.py checks the CV name header against this.

years_experience.description: Total in-cluster years; drives CV length target and seniority judgments.

account.description: The ONLY mailbox the pipeline may read. The mail account guard verifies this before reading anything.

ats_min_score.description: Deterministic ATS score below which /prepare regenerates (max 2 iterations).

shortlist_depth_cap.description: Adaptive intake: above this many shortlisted+ready, /hunt raises the fit bar and halves target_count.

velocity_sla_days.description: Prepare-and-apply window for high-fit jobs before liveness must be re-verified.

extra_role_clusters.description: Cluster ids added on top of the pack's roles.yaml.

location_fit_values.description: Allowed location_fit enum. Default: match, remote_ok, relocation_eu, relocation_non_eu, reject. db.py validates against this UNION values already in the DB.
